Source Monster

Monster: Anjanath | CR: 7 | Tier: 2

Compatible Slots: Armor, Weapon

Weapon Effect

(Bow only) Bow Charge Plus. While attuned to this weapon, you can use your dragonpiercer one additional time between rests and it recharges after a Short or Long rest.

Armor Effect

While you wear this armor, you may pass a Constitution saving throw you otherwise would have failed. Once used, this property can't be used again until you finish a long rest.

Tags: weapon-type:bow, mechanic:class-feature, mechanic:short-rest, mechanic:long-rest
